scope: Proposition 3.1 (Transverse power saving) of the manuscript “Endpoint convergence for the planar Schrodinger equation” (preprints/Endpoint-convergence-for-the-planar-Schrodinger-equation-September-24-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 080 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 68d6affc8c3cc3bc), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 12. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Fix a bounded frequency region. There are c > 0 and L0 < ∞, depending only on that region, for which the following configuration cannot exist when L ≥ L0. Let Q be unit lattice cubes inside a ball of radius L2 in R3, with #Q ≥ L4−c , #{Q ∈ Q : Q ∩ B(z, r) ̸= ∅} ≤ Lc r2 (r ≥ 1), where cube counts may equivalently use their centers, up to fixed constants. Suppose v1, v2, v3 have frequency support in the fixed region, ∥vi∥2 ≤ 1, and sup Q |Evi| ≥ L−4/3−c (Q ∈ Q, i = 1, 2, 3). Then it is impossible that every triple of unit frequency directions, one from each support, has absolute determinant at least L−c.
